title: Mirage F1C (French interceptor)

sources.title: JoyPro cockpit catalog (panels, items and grip functions of the variant)

intro: The Mirage F1C is the French interceptor version of the Mirage F1, a swept-wing jet fighter with one engine from the 1970s, built to find and shoot down enemy aircraft with its Cyrano IV radar and its missiles. The Spanish F1CE that DCS models is a copy of the F1C, so this guide uses the F1CE cockpit: an analogue cockpit with a centre stick, the throttle on the left and a separate radar handle beside it. French radios and navigation equipment may differ in small details from the Spanish ones described here.
